rules.title: An Act prohibiting algorithmic rent setting (S.2983)
rules.requirement: Bill S.2983 would prohibit algorithmic rent setting in Massachusetts rental housing. It is not law: the Housing Committee reported it favorably and sent it to Senate Ways and Means, and the page does not show the bill's text.
rules.requirement_es: El proyecto S.2983 prohibiría la fijación algorítmica de alquileres en la vivienda de alquiler de Massachusetts. Aún no es ley: el Comité de Vivienda lo reportó favorablemente y lo envió al Comité de Medios y Arbitrios del Senado; la página no muestra el texto del proyecto.
rules.quoted_span: of Cindy F. Friedman and Julian Cyr for legislation to prohibit algorithmic rent setting
rules.caveat: Only the bill's title and history are shown, not its operative text. Definitions, prohibited conduct, and penalties are unknown. Current status: referred to Senate Ways and Means.
